album_song_ids.label: Get distinct song IDs from my Spotify album library

reads.spotify__show_song:
data = state["inputs"]
rows = data["playlist_song_ids"]["rows"] if "playlist_song_ids" in data else data["album_song_ids"]["rows"] if "album_song_ids" in data else data["spotify__show_song_library"]["rows"]
return [{"song_id": song} for song in sorted({r["song_id"] for r in rows})]

rank_scoped_songs.label: Select the most or least played or liked song within the indicated collection
rank_scoped_songs.program:
rows = state["inputs"]["spotify__show_song"]["rows"]
goal = state["instruction"]
plays = regex(r"\b(?:most|least)[ -](?:played|listened)\b", goal)
likes = regex(r"\b(?:most|least)[ -]liked\b", goal)
if plays == likes or not rows:
    return None
field = "play_count" if plays else "like_count"
if not all(isinstance(row.get(field), int) for row in rows):
    return None
values = [row[field] for row in rows]
best = min(values) if regex(r"\bleast[ -]", goal) else max(values)
winners = [row for row in rows if row[field] == best]
if len(winners) != 1:
    return None
return {"song_id": winners[0]["song_id"], "title": winners[0]["title"], "metric": field, "value": best}
